messages:
maya: Quick q — who owns the lifecycle for runtime toggles (e.g. routing policies/quota switches)? Thinking about console UX for handoff + audit trail when platform flips traffic or updates a quota.
sam: We don't have an explicit owner on config objects today. Patches are effectively blind, which makes rollbacks and handoffs messy.
kevin: From product side: need canary/staged rollout + clear owner so alerts and escalation point are obvious.
lia: Proposal: extend config schema with `owner_id`, `owner_email`, and `allowed_owners` (team ids). Console shows "Request takeover" when you're not an owner.
maya: API flow idea: `PATCH /configs/:id/ownership` -> 202 with `status: pending_transfer`. Transfer accepted by current owner or an admin. Also need a justification field. Thoughts?
sam: +1, but add TTL on pending_transfer (auto-revert after 24h). Also require `reason` when requesting.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: config-ownership-service v1.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-19T22:10Z :rocket:
kevin: Telemetry: emit events `config.transfer.requested`, `.accepted`, `.rejected`, `.timed_out`. Include `previous_owner`, `requested_by`, `reason`, and `preflight_outcome`.
lia: UX: show recent transfers in right rail + "audit diff" modal. Also add a "simulate takeover" dry-run that runs evals against sample traffic and shows warnings.
sam: API suggestion: prefer `POST /configs/:id/transfer` with body `{to: user_id, dry_run: true}` vs PATCH for explicit semantics.
maya: Big concern: transfers that imply runtime behavior changes (route-by-policy, quota bumps) must run preflight checks: capacity, compatible routing variants, quota budget. If preflight fails — block the transfer.
sam: Agreed. Return `preflight_ok: false` with `warnings` and a `preflight_run_id`. Preflight runs should be re-playable.
kevin: Also consider "delegation tokens" for cross-team ops: team A delegates temporary ownership to team B for X hours with scoped permissions.
lia: Console: "Take ownership" CTA requires a justification text and shows preflight summary. Keep the CTA disabled if preflight fails.
maya: Also need lightweight surrender/rollback: owner can "surrender" ownership and optionally revert to previous owner with a reason within 1h.
sam: Implementation note: use optimistic concurrency with `etag` on the config resource to avoid double-accept races. API returns 409 on mismatch.
lia: Telemetry detail: sample preview runs (simulate takeover) — emit summary metrics only, link to a stored full diff blob (S3) for detailed diffs rather than spamming events.
kevin: Security: only owners + admin role can accept transfers. All transfer events are immutable in audit log.
maya: Ops concern: preflight needs to include quick quota budget check against reserved capacity to avoid surprise throttles.
sam: We'll add a `preflight_checks` enum + `failure_reasons` detail.
lia: I'll mock the console flow in Figma and include the takeover modal + diff rail.
kevin: For telemetry humans: include `team_id` context and sampling flag so we can tune what gets logged in prod.
maya: Can we run a 2-week experiment with 3 teams to validate flow? If ok, we can gate by `feature_flag: ownership_handoff_experiment`.
sam: I'll open an API PR with the `POST /configs/:id/transfer` shape and etag handling.
lia: I'll prototype the UI and a quick prototype that calls the dry_run endpoint. Ping me for UX review.
ops-bot: incident-bot: FYI lowered alert threshold for config-owner-service to 1 failure/min during experiment window.
maya: Thanks — action items: maya write RFC, sam add API PR + schema, lia mock console + figma, kevin telemetry spec. Scheduling a sync Tue 10am. :calendar:
